content:
TrendForce 嘅最新報告指出，iPhone Duo 預計將於 2026 年單年喺摺疊智能手機市場搶佔 24.8% 嘅市場份額，有助抵銷該類別整體 20% 嘅跌幅。以下係詳情。

iPhone Duo is expected to ship 5 million units by the end of 2026.

Following yesterday's announcement of the iPhone Duo, TrendForce today published a report forecasting that Apple will capture 24.8% of the foldable smartphone category by year's end.

TrendForce expects Apple to ship 5 million iPhone Duo units in 2026, which would help offset a category-wide slowdown driven by 'soaring component costs':

The report noted that Samsung is still expected to lead the market with 7 million units shipped and a 35.1% share, while Huawei is projected to also ship 5 million units, likewise holding a 24.8% share.

TrendForce further analysed Apple's hardware choices for the iPhone Duo, including the trade-offs Apple made to achieve the final design:

TrendForce concluded its report by looking ahead at the foldable device category, noting that 'deeper integration of AI and multitasking interfaces with larger foldable screens could transform the device from a hardware differentiation selling point into a new interface for AI applications.'
